<!-- pr-reviewer: ea0b5b733370b02a3a20176b8a0dd778ff9737f2 -->

Verdict: **Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Merge is clean, the delta is as described, no blockers found. This is a DELTA review of the three commits since the last reviewed head (merge `2a86ec090`, re-record `307323f10`, merge `ea0b5b733`), not a full review against main.

## What looks good

- **Merge `2a86ec090`** (main `ec314174e` into `side/path-kernel`): `crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs` is resolved correctly — side's `planner_switch` module and `pub use planner_switch::{PHASE1_KINDS, check_engine, planner_engine}`, main's `wire_comp` module, `AgieSketch` re-export and `mod agie_opening;` are all present, and no line of either side is dropped (verified line-wise). The other two conflicts in the same merge are resolved toward main and both are legitimate: `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs` takes main's #4010 star-cell fix (`BORE_PIN (1642,1614,300)`, with the side's pin preserved as `BORE_PIN_BEFORE_4010 (4688,4660,1980)`), and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` takes main's newer version (authoritative-registry rewrite, shipped `set_program` line superseding the side's gap list, wire-contour `overlap`/`compensation`/`"centre"` and new post list).
- **Re-record `307323f10`**: 11 files, only test/golden fixtures (9 goldens + 2 test files). Attribution is consistent with the commits that changed those outputs: 16 pins from #4014 (ring merge waist) — 8 table rows across `laws_pockets.rs` and `kernel_laws_fig8.rs`, and 8 goldens (`offset2d_fig8_*.cl` x5, `kernel_pocket2d_fig8_*.cl` x3) — and 1 golden from #4008 (trochoidal clean-up engagement) — `kernel_adaptive_trochoidal.cl` with its peel-step / 113.5-deg notes. No kernel pin changed (laws suite green at the head, `kernel_rings` and `kernel_guides` green).
- **Merge `ea0b5b733`** (main `a5e993538`): tree hash equals `git merge-tree --write-tree` of its parents exactly (`3ba112a1ba8f32ee879183c387e7283425f72737`), empty remerge-diff — no hand edit. The #4329 files (`wcs_index.rs`, `mirror_trace/mod.rs`, `wcs_flip/linuxcnc_x.nc`, `setup_wcs_tests.rs`) and the #4326 files (`merge-ready/SKILL.md`, `docs/decisions/4325-path-kernel-delivery.md`) are identical to main. `AGENTS.md` differs from main only by the side branch's own `camcraft-pathkernel` line; `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is unchanged.

## Build evidence (local worktree, `-j 6`, sccache)

Head verified: `ea0b5b733370b02a3a20176b8a0dd778ff9737f2`. No runner build: `pr-test.yml` refuses `xtask/` changes and this PR touches `xtask/` (via the second merge), so the PR was built locally.

- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --tests`: clean, no warnings (2m 04s)
- `cargo test -j 6 -p xtask`: 415 passed, 0 failed (363 unit + integration suites) - xtask green
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-pathkernel`: 168 passed, 0 failed (laws suite 163 + 5) - kernel-side pins green
- motion `kernel_laws` suite (incl. the re-recorded `laws_pockets` readings): 31/31
- app `offset_pass_start`: 15 passed, 0 failed, 18 ignored (the ignored ones are the heavy fig8 pins)
- motion `pass_start_levels` (`kernel_rings`, `kernel_guides`): 45/45
- app `pocket3d_hsm` (the merge-resolved file, debug): 16 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored
- `cargo xtask gate light` (release, -j 6): **7/7 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled** (wall 7.3 min). Includes the three re-recorded fig8 readings (`fig8_adaptive_2d`, `fig8_offset_2d`, `fig8_pocket_3d`) and the re-recorded `pocket_pass_start` golden twin (`waterline_auto`) - the fixtures this delta re-records.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --lib` (the merged post changes): 175 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --test wcs_flip --test wcs_flip_dialects` (the wcs_flip golden of the second merge): 32 passed, 0 failed
- Batch gate: author claims `1234 steps, 0 failed` on this head (`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6 ... xtask gate batch`, 70.2 min, clippy and example_catalog included). Not re-run by this review -- the quick plan falls back to batch (a shared crate is touched: `crates/geometry/src/die_opening.rs`), and a batch gate had already started in the main checkout concurrently. This review ran clippy, xtask, pathkernel, the re-recorded suites and the light lane on the head.
- The heavy pins (`offset_pass_start` shared_planner / fig8 / planner_switch 9 passed, `pocket_pass_start` kernel_baseline 2 passed) are the author's release `--ignored` run -- not re-run here; their light twins are green (see the light-lane line above).

## Findings

None blocking. The delta is as described and the merge resolutions are correct.

## Notes (not blocking)

1. The PR body says "One textual conflict, in the first merge" - it is three (verified with `git merge-tree --write-tree`): `mod.rs`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs`. The resolution is right; only the count is wrong. `git diff --remerge-diff 2a86ec090` lists the three files.
2. No "Process change: yes" line in the body, and AGENTS.md is in the merge set. The #4112 sync precedent carries no such line for the same kind of sync, so this is not a blocker; the merging session still bumps `PROCESS_VERSION` after the batch (merge batch rule).
3. `main` moved 26 commits past `a5e993538` since the head - a sync, not a blocker. The next sync or the side-branch-to-main PR takes them.

The second merge carries main's #4329 post fix (mirror trace + wcs flip) unchanged - its post suites (`wcs_flip`, `wcs_flip_dialects`, `camcraft-post --lib`) were run on the head and are green. The example-catalog suites are not re-run here (the batch gate of the head covers them; the quick plan falls back to batch).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
